items.title: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers’ private data
items.summary: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec

items.title: Fan fiction site Archive of Our Own could be offline for up to 4 weeks
items.summary: Archive of Our Own, the popular online home of fan fiction readers and writers, has bad news for its community.
items.creator: Amanda Silberling

items.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
items.summary: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
items.summary: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec
